tasks.subject: Task 1: GainControl DSP + unit tests
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A standalone GainControl (pure Kotlin) that adapts a smoothed gain toward a target RMS, freezes during non-speech, is bidirectional, and soft-limits its output — with deterministic JVM tests.

**Files:**
- Create: app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/GainControl.kt
- Test: app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/GainControlTest.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Gain converges output RMS to target within 1 dB on a steady tone
- Gain frozen at 1.0 across non-speech sub-frames
- Loud sub-frame at high gain stays below full scale (no wrap)
- Gain stays within [minGain,maxGain]
- enabled=false is bit-exact passthrough
- deterministic

**Verify:** JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests "*GainControlTest"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/GainControl.kt", "app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/GainControlTest.kt"], "verifyCommand": "JAVA_HOME=\"/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home\" ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests \"*GainControlTest\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Gain converges output RMS to target within 1 dB on a steady tone", "Gain frozen at 1.0 across non-speech sub-frames", "Loud sub-frame at high gain stays below full scale (no wrap)", "Gain stays within [minGain,maxGain]", "enabled=false is bit-exact passthrough", "deterministic"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Apply GainControl in TransmitProcessor
tasks.description:
**Goal:** TransmitProcessor applies the gain per sub-frame after RNNoise in both process() (voice-activated) and denoise() (PTT), reading the RNNoise probability through its existing vad field, without breaking the existing denoise-only test.

**Files:**
- Modify: app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/TransmitProcessor.kt
- Test: app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/TransmitProcessorTest.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- gain param defaults to disabled GainControl; 3-arg call sites unchanged
- process() applies gain after vad.level (gate sees pre-gain)
- denoise() reads prob and applies gain only when gain.enabled
- existing TransmitProcessorTest tests still pass
- new test: enabled gain reads prob once per sub-frame in denoise

**Verify:** JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests "*TransmitProcessorTest"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/TransmitProcessor.kt", "app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/TransmitProcessorTest.kt"], "verifyCommand": "JAVA_HOME=\"/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home\" ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests \"*TransmitProcessorTest\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["gain param defaults to disabled GainControl; 3-arg call sites unchanged", "process() applies gain after vad.level (gate sees pre-gain)", "denoise() reads prob and applies gain only when gain.enabled", "existing TransmitProcessorTest tests still pass", "new test: enabled gain reads prob once per sub-frame in denoise"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Eval-harness AGC scoreboard
tasks.description:
**Goal:** An automated regression guard proving the makeup gain converges corpus clips toward the target, shrinks cross-clip loudness spread vs no-AGC, and never clips.

**Files:**
- Modify: app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/eval/VadEvaluator.kt
- Test: app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/eval/AgcEvaluationTest.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- evaluate(clip, gain?) runs pipeline with optional gain; null keeps existing behavior
- with AGC on, every clip's speechLoudnessDbFs moves toward -18 and clipping==0
- cross-clip loudness spread strictly smaller with AGC than without
- existing VadEvaluationTest unaffected

**Verify:** JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests "*AgcEvaluationTest" --tests "*VadEvaluationTest"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/eval/VadEvaluator.kt", "app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/eval/AgcEvaluationTest.kt"], "verifyCommand": "JAVA_HOME=\"/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home\" ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests \"*AgcEvaluationTest\" --tests \"*VadEvaluationTest\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["evaluate(clip, gain?) runs pipeline with optional gain; null keeps existing behavior", "with AGC on, every clip's speechLoudnessDbFs moves toward -18 and clipping==0", "cross-clip loudness spread strictly smaller with AGC than without", "existing VadEvaluationTest unaffected"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Retune GainControl to smoothed loudness
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Fix GainControl steady-state undershoot + gain hunting by adapting against a smoothed mean-square loudness (EMA over speech, ~400ms) instead of instantaneous 10ms RMS — mirrors Mumble's accumulated-loudness AGC. Discovered during Task 6 (the eval scoreboard caught the undershoot/hunting).

**Files:**
- Modify: app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/GainControl.kt
- Test: app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/GainControlTest.kt

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- adapts against smoothed mean-square EMA (loudnessWindowMs default 400, seeded first speech frame, frozen during non-speech)
- existing GainControlTest tests still pass
- new test: gain stable under alternating loud/quiet input (settled-gain-band, discriminates old vs new)
- new test: output converges to target under varying input
- eval AgcEvaluationTest flips to passing

**Verify:** JAVA_HOME="/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home" ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests "*GainControlTest" --tests "*AgcEvaluationTest"

```json:metadata
{"files": ["app/src/main/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/GainControl.kt", "app/src/test/java/me/danielstiner/dumble/mumble/voice/GainControlTest.kt"], "verifyCommand": "JAVA_HOME=\"/Applications/Android Studio.app/Contents/jbr/Contents/Home\" ./gradlew :app:testDebugUnitTest --tests \"*GainControlTest\" --tests \"*AgcEvaluationTest\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["adapts against smoothed mean-square EMA", "existing GainControlTest tests pass", "new stability test discriminates old vs new", "new varying-input convergence test", "eval scoreboard passes"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```
